decision: Sky School: Mars opposition, with the orbit geometry from orbit3d and the 101 million km distance from computed ephemerides
rationale: Opposition is the one 'why' topic the renderer can depict truthfully: orbit3d draws Earth and Mars, so the inside-track pass can be animated instead of asserted. The distance is computed for the opposition instant (101.4 million km) and the 55.8-401 million km range is NASA sourced, which turns an abstract definition into a concrete number. Publishing in Feb 2027 also fills the calendar gap between the Quadrantids and the spring.
alternatives: Explain a lunar eclipse instead (rejected: orbit3d has no Moon, so the geometry could not be shown)
Do a 'how far is Mars' fact card only (rejected: no visual payoff)
